# Dropdown Item

`@kerfjs/ui:wa-dropdown-item` · Web Awesome · component · Actions · recommendation: avoid

## When to use

Ecosystem action-menu row; use Kerf PopupMenu items or Select choices.

- Action-menu row; prefer Kerf Select options for value selection.

**Not when:**

- Do not use it in Kerf UI; use PopupMenu items for commands and Select choices for values.

**Alternatives:**

- [PopupMenu](./popup-menu.md) (prefer-kerf) — Use PopupMenu items for commands and Select choices for values.
- [Select](./select.md) (prefer-kerf) — Use PopupMenu items for commands and Select choices for values.

## Imports

- Theme CSS: import `@kerfjs/ui/webawesome.css` once.
- Registration: import `@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/components/dropdown-item/dropdown-item.js` once (a side effect).
- Custom element: `<wa-dropdown-item>`.
- Declared side effects: custom-element-registration.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: self · padding: self (layout role: actions). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

No component-specific obligations beyond native semantics and a visible or accessible name for every control.

The component renders a native control or link as its root, so it cannot sit in another such component's zones, and its own zones cannot hold a control, a link, or a component that renders one. (`KUI-V014`)

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Theme it only through `@kerfjs/ui/webawesome.css` and cataloged tokens. Do not restyle its shadow DOM or uncataloged `::part()` targets (`KUI-L011`).
